messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for release v3.2.1 -> canary 10% (us-west-2).
maya: Noted. Watching p95 + 5xx now.
alex: I already see /v1/generate 5xx spike, ~3% on canary, baseline 0.4% :eyes:
maya: stack traces point to adapter timeout, 2x latency on redis calls. digging.
samir: can we hold the rollout? deploy-bot's policy would auto-roll back at 5xx>2% for 5m, but we're at 3% now.
li: prefer manual hold to investigate unless it keeps climbing. we need to preserve canary data for root cause.
maya: agree. @deploy-bot pause traffic for canary slice.
deploy-bot: pausing rollout: canary traffic frozen at 10%. Reason: manual_hold_by_maya.
alex: capture traces + top logs, and create short incident note. I'll pin a snippet.
alex: logs:
```bash
2026-03-20T14:05:12Z inference-adapter ERROR downstream timeout id=0x7fa3
2026-03-20T14:05:12Z redis-client WARN slow-query 120ms key=kvcache
```
maya: quick mitigation idea: revert adapter change in canary from v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0, keep production untouched.
samir: approve. revert command below, testing in staging already green:
```bash
infractl rollback --service inference --env canary --to-version v3.2.0
```
li: oncall and support notified. support-bot: @support paged: prod-impact=False, canary-only.
maya: executing revert now, will follow up with postmortem note and release notes update.
maya: ETA ~6m to complete and validate.
samir: once canary stabilizes we can re-open rollout after root cause fix or new build.
li: add a small entry to changelog: 'reverted adapter tweak for canary due to intermittent redis timeouts'.
maya: pinging @oncall to keep eyes on latency for 30m after revert :thumbsup:
support-bot: acknowledged. standby for customer comms if it spikes.
